payload.name: Compress PDF to 10MB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup PDF compressor for wider 10MB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based PDF compressor for 10MB email, support, school, document, and portal upload limits that still reject large scans. It opens the local PDF compressor with a 10MB target, keeps ordinary files on the device, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
